title: Employee Meal Account Plans: Entry Gate, Enrolment Charge and Badge Schedule
content:
Six plans make up the Employee Meal Account line at Larkspur Table Workplace Dining Group, and this schedule prints, plan by plan, the entry gate an employee must meet to be enrolled on it, what opening the account costs, how many accounts they may hold, how many dependents may be added, what a replacement site badge costs, how long the account is frozen once a badge loss is reported, how often a statement is issued and whether ordering ahead from the mobile app is offered.

## The entry gate, plan by plan

| Meal plan | Months of service required to enrol | Employer must run the programme | Payroll consent must stand recorded | A manager must have approved |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | 0 months | no | no | no |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | 0 months | yes | no | no |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | 3 months | yes | yes | no |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | 3 months | yes | yes | no |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | 6 months | yes | no | yes |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | 12 months | yes | yes | yes |

The gate of a plan is the four conditions printed against it, taken together: the months of employment already served, whether the plan is open only where the employer runs the programme, whether payroll consent must stand recorded, and whether a manager's approval must stand.

## Enrolment charge, accounts and badge terms

| Meal plan | Charge to open an account | Accounts one employee may hold on this plan | Dependents who may be added | Replacement badge charge | Freeze after a reported badge loss | Statement issued | Order ahead from the mobile app |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | $0.00 | 2 | 0 | $12.00 | 24 hours | none issued | no |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | $5.00 | 2 | 0 | $12.00 | 24 hours | monthly | yes |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | $0.00 | 2 | 0 | $12.00 | 12 hours | each payroll period | yes |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | $0.00 | 2 | 0 | $12.00 | 12 hours | monthly | yes |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | $0.00 | 1 | 0 | $0.00 | 12 hours | monthly | yes |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | $25.00 | 1 | 2 | $0.00 | 4 hours | each payroll period | yes |

## What each column means

1. The months of service required to enrol are whole months of employment the employee must already have served before the plan accepts them.
2. The charge to open an account is the one-off amount raised for opening an Employee Meal Account on that plan.
3. The accounts one employee may hold at once on the plan, and the dependents who may be added to the account, are both whole numbers; where a plan prints one account, that is the whole of the employee's entitlement on it.
4. The replacement badge charge is raised for replacing a lost site badge linked to the account, and the freeze figure is the number of hours the account is frozen from a reported loss.
5. Statement frequency and mobile ordering are printed as the plan carries them, the first being how often a statement is issued and the second whether the employee may order ahead from the mobile app.

## Points of judgement

The entry service figure is read in whole months served, so an employee with 3 months served meets a plan printing 3 months and an employee with 2 months does not. The Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account is the only plan in the line printing no entry service, no enrolment charge and none of the three further entry conditions; the Executive Dining Charge Account, printing 12 months of service, a $25.00 charge and all three further conditions, stands at the closed end. Payroll consent is printed against 3 of the six plans and a manager's approval against 2, and the two are not printed together on every plan that carries either. Where a plan prints $0.00 against the replacement badge charge, a replacement badge is issued at no charge on that plan.
